# Custom analysis of resulting models

```{r}
library(jsonlite)
#reading in my protein structure from Alpha fold.  
#set pathing and read in a pdb file
library(bio3d)
pdb <- read.pdb("FindageneprojectCMSS1homolog_23c00/FindageneprojectCMSS1homolog_23c00_unrelaxed_rank_001_alphafold2_ptm_model_1_seed_000.pdb")
pdb
```

```{r}
#Making a vector of input PDB file names that we can read into R
# Change this for YOUR results dir name
results_dir <- "FindageneprojectCMSS1homolog_23c00/"
pdb_files <- list.files("FindageneprojectCMSS1homolog_23c00/", pattern= ".pdb", full.names = TRUE)
pdb_files
```

```{r}

# Read all data from Models 
#  and superpose/fit coords
pdbs <- pdbaln(pdb_files, fit=TRUE, exefile="msa")

```

```{r}
# view sequences
pdbs

```

```{r}
#rmsd gets the structural distance between the sets of coordinates 
rd <- rmsd(pdbs, fit=T)
range(rd)
```

```{r}
# drawing a heatmap of these RMSD matrix values

library(pheatmap)

colnames(rd) <- paste0("m",1:5)
rownames(rd) <- paste0("m",1:5)
pheatmap(rd)
```

```{r}
# Read a reference PDB structure
pdb <- read.pdb("1hsg")

```

```{r}
plotb3(pdbs$b[1,], typ="l", lwd=2, sse=pdb)
points(pdbs$b[2,], typ="l", col="red")
points(pdbs$b[3,], typ="l", col="blue")
points(pdbs$b[4,], typ="l", col="darkgreen")
points(pdbs$b[5,], typ="l", col="orange")
abline(v=100, col="gray")
```

```{r}
core <- core.find(pdbs)
```

```{r}

core.inds <- print(core, vol=0.5)

```

```{r}
xyz <- pdbfit(pdbs, core.inds, outpath="corefit_structures")

```

```{r}
rf <- rmsf(xyz)

plotb3(rf, sse=pdb)
abline(v=100, col="gray", ylab="RMSF")
```

```{r}
# File names for all PDB models
pdb_files <- list.files(path=results_dir,
                        pattern="*.pdb",
                        full.names = TRUE)

# Print our PDB file names
basename(pdb_files)
```


```{r}

# Read all data from Models 
#  and superpose/fit coords
pdbs <- pdbaln(pdb_files, fit=TRUE, exefile="msa")
```

```{r}
pdbs
```

```{r}
rd <- rmsd(pdbs, fit=T)
range(rd)
```

```{r}
library(pheatmap)

colnames(rd) <- paste0("m",1:5)
rownames(rd) <- paste0("m",1:5)
pheatmap(rd)
```

```{r}
# Read a reference PDB structure
pdb <- read.pdb(pdb_files[1])
plotb3(pdbs$b[1,], typ="l", lwd=2)
points(pdbs$b[2,], typ="l", col="red")
points(pdbs$b[3,], typ="l", col="blue")
points(pdbs$b[4,], typ="l", col="darkgreen")
points(pdbs$b[5,], typ="l", col="orange")


```

```{r}
# finding the most consistent rigid core: 
core <- core.find(pdbs)
```

```{r}
# using the core atom positions to make a superposition and write it to a new directory. 
core.inds <- print(core, vol=0.5)
xyz <- pdbfit(pdbs, core.inds, outpath="corefit_structures")
```

![](images/clipboard-1513278390.png)

Figure 1. 5 structures that are core superimposed, and colored by B-factor.

```{r}
# examining the RMSF between positions of the structure. 
rf <- rmsf(xyz)

plotb3(rf, sse=pdb)
abline(v=100, col="gray", ylab="RMSF")
```

The first chain is vary variable while the second is more consistent across other models.

# Predicted Alignment Error for domains

```{r}
library(jsonlite)

# Listing of all PAE JSON files
pae_files <- list.files(path=results_dir,
                        pattern=".*model.*\\.json",
                        full.names = TRUE)
```

```{r}
#readig example json files, changed to 2 and 4 from the example which had 1 and 5. 
pae2 <- read_json(pae_files[2],simplifyVector = TRUE)
pae4 <- read_json(pae_files[4],simplifyVector = TRUE)

attributes(pae2)
```

```{r}
#looking at the pae values to see which model is best. 
# Per-residue pLDDT scores 
#  same as B-factor of PDB..
head(pae2$plddt) 
pae2$max_pae
pae4$max_pae
```

models 2 and 4 have very similar scores.

```{r}
# making an N by N plot 
plot.dmat(pae2$pae, 
          xlab="Residue Position (i)",
          ylab="Residue Position (j)")
```

```{r}
#plot for pae4
plot.dmat(pae4$pae, 
          xlab="Residue Position (i)",
          ylab="Residue Position (j)",
          grid.col = "black",
          zlim=c(0,30))
```

```{r}
# new plot but with fixed z range
plot.dmat(pae2$pae, 
          xlab="Residue Position (i)",
          ylab="Residue Position (j)",
          grid.col = "black",
          zlim=c(0,30))
plot.dmat(pae4$pae, 
          xlab="Residue Position (i)",
          ylab="Residue Position (j)",
          grid.col = "black",
          zlim=c(0,30))
```

#Residue conservation from alignment file

```{r}
aln_file <- list.files(path=results_dir,
                       pattern=".a3m$",
                        full.names = TRUE)
aln_file
aln <- read.fasta(aln_file[1], to.upper = TRUE)
```

Number of sequences in the alignment:

```{r}
dim(aln$ali)
```

```{r}
#scoring residue conservation
sim <- conserv(aln)
plotb3(sim[1:99], sse=trim.pdb(pdb, chain="A"),
       ylab="Conservation Score")

```

```{r}
# making a consensus sequence
con <- consensus(aln, cutoff = 0.9)
con$seq
```

Seems to not have any stand out consesnsus residues

```{r}
#mapping the conservation score to the occupancy column of a pdb structure 
m1.pdb <- read.pdb(pdb_files[1])
occ <- vec2resno(sim[1:278], m1.pdb$atom$resno)
write.pdb(m1.pdb, o=occ, file="m1_conserv.pdb")
```

![](images/clipboard-2357504530.png)

Figure 2. structure of CMSS1 viewed in Mol\* colored by Occupancy.
